outcome: mean pulsatility index of bilateral UA (UAPI)
early diastolic notch in the velocity waveform
cohort: The participants were 76 patients diagnosed with pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH).
finding: The study found significant differences in uterine artery blood flow and resistance between early-onset and late-onset pregnancy-induced hypertension, with the early-onset group consistently showing a higher UA pulsatility index and resistance from the second to third trimester.
